toolchain: abaplint/transpiler 2.14.34 with abaplint/core 2.120.105 plus local string projection support and Node SQLite
semantic_scope: The abaplint parser and relational transpiler translated the original CDS to SQLite. A small adapter routes projected string literals through the transpiler’s existing SQL literal emitter. Querying the generated view after creating and populating its declared client table produced the expected client and greeting.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
